image_description: An underwater photograph showing a hammerhead shark swimming diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. The shark's distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible, with eyes at the tips. The body is greyish-brown on top and lighter underneath. A tall dorsal fin and pectoral fins are visible. The background is dark blue water with some particulate matter and faint outlines of other fish or structures in the distance.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays the characteristic T-shaped head structure extending laterally from the body axis.
